purpose: Lossless-first vector compression and correlated evidence/data cache for faster synthesis without destroying auditability.
rules: DISSENT AND CONTRADICTIONS MUST SURVIVE COMPRESSION

stores.correlation_bank: relationships and shared dependencies; never evidence by itself
stores.synthesis_bank: compact references to source hashes plus explicit status

note: No additional real AI agents are created by this layer. It reduces duplicate work and prepares tasks for whatever real runtimes are available.
